name: Irina Volkov
bio:
Irina Volkov brings a wealth of experience to Ferrari AF Corse, having honed her skills in the demanding world of high-end catering for over two decades. Her journey into motorsport was somewhat unexpected, sparked by a chance encounter with a team owner while catering a private event in Monaco. Impressed by her meticulous attention to detail and ability to handle complex logistical challenges, he offered her a position within the team's hospitality division.

Irina approaches her role with a no-nonsense attitude, prioritizing efficiency and quality above all else. She believes that a well-fed and comfortable team is a productive team, and she takes pride in ensuring that every member has access to nutritious and delicious meals throughout the racing season. Her ability to source the finest ingredients from local markets, even in the most remote locations, sets her apart, making her an invaluable asset to the team. Irina's pragmatic approach to problem-solving ensures that the catering operation runs smoothly, regardless of the challenges that arise.

physical.hairStyle: Neatly styled bob with subtle layers framing her face
physical.description: Irina is a woman of medium height with a sturdy build that speaks to her years of hands-on experience.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with recipes and ingredient lists.
Has a habit of taste-testing every dish, even if she's prepared it hundreds of times.
Insists on using fresh herbs, even if it means growing them herself in a small container garden near the paddock.
